discordOverview.title: Discord Overview
discordOverview.description: OwOGG operates via signed HTTP Interactions, not as an always-online bot. Installation, account linking, and server registration are 3 separate steps.
discordOverview.calloutStrong: General users do not need to manage Bot Token, Application ID, or Public Key.
discordOverview.calloutBody: These values are managed as GitHub Actions Secrets exclusively by the OwOGG operations team.
discordOverview.step1: Add the OwOGG app to Discord (requires Manage Server permission).
discordOverview.step2: Verify and authorize the selected server.
discordOverview.step3: Return to OwOGG and link your Discord account.
discordOverview.step4: Register a server you manage as an OwOGG community.
discordOverview.step5: Start on Discord with /owogg games and /owogg play.

discordInstall.title: Installing OwOGG on Discord
discordInstall.description: Installing the Discord app is the preparation step to use OwOGG on your server. It is separate from server registration.
discordInstall.calloutStrong: General users do not need to enter a Bot Token.
discordInstall.calloutBody: Simply click the official installation link below and follow Discord's server selection and authorization screens.
discordInstall.step1: Click the [Add OwOGG to Discord] button below.
discordInstall.step2: Ensure you are logged into your Discord account.
discordInstall.step3: Select the server to add the app to (only servers where you have Manage Server permission will appear in the list).
discordInstall.step4: Review and authorize the requested permissions.
discordInstall.step5: After completion, return to OwOGG to proceed with account linking and server registration.

discordAccountLink.title: Account Linking
discordAccountLink.description: Linking your Discord account to your OwOGG account enables using your profile info in bot commands (such as /owogg profile, /owogg play).
discordAccountLink.step1: Enter the /owogg link command in a Discord server.
discordAccountLink.step2: The bot responds with a one-time linking link visible only to you (ephemeral).
discordAccountLink.step3: Click the link to navigate to the OwOGG web application.
discordAccountLink.step4: If you are not logged into OwOGG, log in first.
discordAccountLink.step5: Authorize on the linking confirmation screen to complete.
discordAccountLink.calloutPrefix: The linking link is one-time use and expires after a set period. If expired or already used, run
discordAccountLink.calloutSuffix: again in Discord to get a new link.
discordAccountLink.calloutWarning: A single Discord account can only be linked to one OwOGG account. If a Discord account is already linked to another OwOGG account, it cannot be newly linked — you must un-link it on the web first.

discordServerRegistration.title: Server Registration
discordServerRegistration.description: App installation and server registration are separate. You must complete server registration to activate server XP, leaderboards, and server-dedicated pages.
discordServerRegistration.req1: You must be logged into your OwOGG account.
discordServerRegistration.req2: You must have Manage Server permission on the Discord server you wish to register.
discordServerRegistration.req3: The OwOGG app must already be installed on that server.
discordServerRegistration.step1: Start Discord server registration authorization while logged into OwOGG.
discordServerRegistration.step2: Authorize the permissions requested by Discord (verify server list).
discordServerRegistration.step3: Select the server to register from the list of manageable servers.
discordServerRegistration.step4: Set the server slug (URL name), description, and visibility.
discordServerRegistration.step5: Upon completion, a dedicated server page will be created immediately.
discordServerRegistration.visibilityPublicDesc: Exposed in the OwOGG server directory and search.
discordServerRegistration.visibilityUnlistedDesc: Accessible only via direct link, not exposed in the directory.
discordServerRegistration.calloutBody: Installing the app does not make the server public automatically. You must register directly following the procedure above.

discordCommands.title: Commands
discordCommands.description: All OwOGG Discord commands are subcommands of /owogg.
discordCommands.calloutEphemeral: Displayed responses are temporary (ephemeral) messages visible only to the user who ran the command — invisible to others in the channel.

commands.name: /owogg link
commands.purpose: Links this Discord account to an OwOGG account.
commands.commonError: If already linked, an informational message is sent instead of a new link.

commands.name: /owogg profile
commands.purpose: Checks the nickname, level, and total XP of the linked OwOGG account.
commands.commonError: If the account is not linked, a /owogg link prompt is sent.

commands.name: /owogg games
commands.purpose: Checks the list of playable games and links currently available on OwOGG.
commands.where: Server channel or DM, no login required

commands.name: /owogg play
commands.purpose: Issues a one-time gameplay link where XP is credited to this server.
commands.args: game (optional) — Specify a game; if omitted, navigates to game list
commands.commonError: An informational message is sent if the server is unregistered or account unlinked. Links are valid once for 15 minutes.

commands.name: /owogg rank
commands.purpose: Checks your rank and server-contributed XP within this server.
commands.commonError: An informational message is sent if account is unlinked or no activity exists in this server yet.

commands.name: /owogg leaderboard
commands.purpose: Checks the Top 10 OwOGG XP leaderboard for this server.
commands.commonError: An informational message is sent if the server is unregistered.

commands.name: /owogg server
commands.purpose: Checks total XP and weekly activity summary for this server.
commands.commonError: An informational message is sent if the server is unregistered.

discordXp.description: Global XP, Per-Guild User XP, and Guild Activity XP are three distinct numbers.
discordXp.differHeading: The Three Types of XP Differ
discordXp.globalDesc: — Account-wide cumulative experience points. Used for profile and global rankings.
discordXp.guildActivityDesc: — The sum contributed by all server members, used for server leaderboards and weekly rankings.

discordXp.cardGuildBText: Existing XP is not automatically copied
discordXp.calloutNoCopyStrong: Existing Global XP is not automatically copied to new servers.
discordXp.calloutNoCopyBody: Newly registered servers always start at 0, and only new valid plays made in that server will accumulate.
discordXp.calloutAbuseBody: Global XP payout per User × Game × UTC Day is capped at 10 times max. Once the cap is reached, game completion remains possible, but no additional XP is rewarded. A single play event belongs to at most one server — the same completion will not generate XP redundantly across multiple servers.

discordTroubleshooting.title: Troubleshooting
discordTroubleshooting.description: Find solutions by symptom. In no case does a general user need to configure a Bot Token.
discordTroubleshooting.calloutWarning: None of the symptoms below require entering a Bot Token, Application ID, or Public Key. If prompted for these, it may not be an official OwOGG channel.

faqAutocomplete.question: /owogg does not show up in autocomplete
faqAutocomplete.answerPrefix: Try restarting your Discord client or leaving and re-joining the server. If it still doesn't appear, ask a server administrator to check if the app is actually installed on the server. OwOGG operations team can verify global command registration status via

faqPlainMessage.question: Entered /owogg link but it posted as a regular message
faqPlainMessage.answer: If sent as plain text instead of a normal slash command, Discord failed to recognize the command. You must select /owogg from the autocomplete list and select the subcommand to execute. Typing it out manually and sending makes it a regular message.

faqNoResponse.question: The application did not respond
faqNoResponse.answer: This could be a temporary delay or error. Please try again after a moment. If repeated, there may be an issue with OwOGG service status, so please check again later.

faqAlreadyLinked.question: It says the account is already linked
faqAlreadyLinked.answer: This means your Discord account is already linked to another OwOGG account. A single Discord account can only be linked to one OwOGG account. To link to another account, you must un-link the existing connection on the web first.

faqServerNotRegistered.question: /owogg play says server is unregistered
faqServerNotRegistered.answerPrefix: This Discord server has not been registered as an OwOGG community yet. A server administrator must complete
faqServerNotRegistered.answerSuffix: . Installing the app alone does not register the server.

faqNotInCandidateList.question: Server is not in the registration list (candidate list)
faqNotInCandidateList.answer: The registrable server list only displays servers where you actually have Manage Server permissions. Verify if you have permissions or if the logged-in Discord account is the intended account.

faqBotNotVisible.question: Bot is not visible in the Discord member list
faqBotNotVisible.answer: OwOGG operates via signed HTTP Interactions instead of an always-connected (Gateway) bot. Thus, it may not always display as "Online" in the member list — this is normal and does not affect command functionality.

faqBotOffline.question: Bot appears offline
faqBotOffline.answer: For the same reason above. Apps based on HTTP Interactions do not maintain an always-on connection state, so they may show as offline in the Discord member list. If commands execute normally, this is not an issue.
